digest.component_or_area: completion verification harness (in-process vs external agent)
propositions: Production in-process verifier (Arm A) achieved 100% per-AC ground-truth agreement and zero rejections on real acceptance criteria, while minimal free-tool harness agent (Arm B) produced 5 false-FAIL rejections on real ACs and 94.6% agreement.
Arm B wall-time median (415.5 s) exceeded 2× Arm A median (131 s), violating the predeclared performance threshold.

All 5 Arm B false-FAIL verdicts concentrated on epic AC7 and AC2, stemming from strict literal readings of coverage clauses (stamp/mapping mutation commit locality, enrichment data presence) rather than tooling constraints.
Arm B output validation remained clean across all 12 runs with zero harness errors, retries, or failed reps, indicating robust subagent stability despite stricter rejection behavior.

Predeclared GO decision rule failed on conditions (ii) and (iii): Arm B rejections were not strictly fewer than Arm A, and wall time was not within 2× threshold, resulting in NO-GO recommendation against external-harness verifier integration.
